blockingIssues: Light-theme control boundaries do not meet WCAG AA non-text contrast. ThemeToggle uses a white background with `light:border-slate-300`, and the Appearance select uses `light:border-blue-300` on white; these borders are below the required 3:1 contrast and make unfocused controls insufficiently distinguishable. Strengthen the borders or provide an equivalent 3:1 boundary.
suggestions: Run frontend tests and lint; only the desktop build is recorded.

evidence.detail: The light toggle style uses `light:bg-white light:border-slate-300`; against the white header, the border contrast is approximately 1.5:1.
The Appearance select uses `light:bg-white light:border-blue-300`; the blue-300 border against white is approximately 1.8:1.
Both light-mode join inputs use `light:border-slate-300 light:bg-slate-50` inside white cards, leaving their unfocused boundaries below 3:1 contrast.
